title: Bikramjit Singh v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Bikramjit Singh v. State of Punjab, (2020) 10 SCC 616
content.holding: Held that default bail is an intrinsic part of the right to personal liberty under Article 21; an oral or written readiness to furnish bail upon expiry of the statutory period instantly triggers the right.
content.relevance: Mandatory citation in default bail applications where prosecution attempts to delay hearing.
